body.message:
Thank you for your response.

I do, however, have some concerns regarding the statement that our booking was made under a non-refundable rate. At no point during the booking process do we recall being informed that the reservation was non-refundable, nor were we asked to sign or agree to any terms clearly stating that unused nights would not be eligible for a refund.

If this was a condition of the booking, could you please provide us with the documentation or booking terms that show where this was disclosed and agreed to?

Regarding our departure, we will be packing and moving out over the weekend, and we can now confirm that our final check-out date will be Sunday, 2 August.

We appreciate your confirmation that the security deposit will be refunded within 7 working days after the inspection, provided no damages that weren’t already apart of the unit are found, as there were a few minor damages like the floor board bridges and appliances not working like the vacuum ect.

We look forward to your response regarding the non-refundable booking terms.

Kind regards,
